adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is normalized to lowercase (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` strings are not normalized before comparison. The filter uses case-sensitive checks: `guest === attendee.email` and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Since neither `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` nor the UI lowercases emails, a differently-cased email (e.g., `User@X.com`) can evade both the existing-attendee dedupe and the blacklist, leading to duplicate attendee creation (`createMany`) and extra emails being sent.
